summary: Store footer: logo or title, tagline, contacts, menu columns, legal line. Composite.
rules: Never invent menu ids: `modules[].menu` and `legalInfo.menu` are menus that exist in the cabinet. Keep the pulled ones; a new column (a footer with `modules: []` included) takes the id of a menu the merchant has made in the cabinet, written into `modules[].menu` together with its `menuTitle`. Without such a menu, ask the merchant to make one rather than ship a footer without columns.
Always send `about.description`, even as an empty string.
Turn a `contacts.show*` toggle off when the cabinet value is empty or a placeholder (an all-zero phone).

`about.enableSocialNetworks` shows the social links of the cabinet's «О компании»: the presets switch it on, so write `false` when the store has none there (ask the merchant, or look at the live footer), or the footer keeps an empty row.
Never invent `image` media. The empty value is `{"imageInfo": {"fileId": "", "filePath": "", "sizes": []}, "url": ""}`.
A footer with no columns, no legal links and no social links looks unfinished: 35 of 41 stores run 1-2 titled menu columns.
Keep the fields that pulled `modules[]` items carry (`id`, `display_sequence`, `title`) when editing.

Give every menu column a `menuTitle`: on phones a titled column collapses into an accordion (about 300 px), an untitled one prints its whole list (600-900 px with two menus). About half the sample's footers leave columns untitled.

module_template.menu: <fill: existing menu id from the pulled footer>
module_template.menuTitle: <fill: column title, e.g. Каталог or Покупателям>

presets.name: dark-footer-columns
presets.use: The closing band on a dark palette: logo, tagline, contacts, 1-2 menu columns.
presets.evidence: about 14 stores on a dark footer
fill: `palette`: id of an existing dark palette (theme preset `palettes-three-roles` adds one).
`about.description`: one-line tagline from the merchant (20-45 characters) or empty.
`modules`: keep the pulled columns; a new column (the first one too, when the footer has none) takes the id of a menu made in the cabinet, with its `menuTitle`.
`modules[].menuTitle`: a title on every column (e.g. «Каталог», «Покупателям»), keeping each module's `menu`, `id` and `display_sequence`.
`contacts.show*`: keep the store's switches; turn one off where the cabinet value is empty or a placeholder.
`about.enableSocialNetworks`: `false` when the store has no social links in the cabinet.
`about.monochromeLogo`: `true` when the logo is dark and would vanish on the dark palette.
The logo on the dark palette: an inverted logo uploaded in the cabinet, or `monochromeLogo: true` in the footer's about module; otherwise a dark logo disappears on the dark band.

`modules[].menuTitle`: a title on every column (e.g. «Каталог», «Покупателям»), keeping each module's `menu`, `id` and `display_sequence`.
